requirements.title: Account registration and sign in
requirements.description: Student and faculty register; administrator is provisioned by operator.

requirements.title: Report a lost item
requirements.description: Capture title description category location and date; create pending report.

requirements.title: Report a found item
requirements.description: Use the same validated workflow with kind found.

requirements.title: Search verified reports
requirements.description: Search title description location and filter kind/category.

requirements.title: Private owner or finder contact
requirements.description: Authenticated contact through recipient-scoped internal inbox.

requirements.title: Owner-only recovery
requirements.description: Only the reporting user can close an open verified report.

requirements.title: Administrator moderation
requirements.description: Administrator verifies or soft-removes suspicious reports with reason.

requirements.title: Personal report tracking
requirements.description: Owner can see their pending verified and removed reports.

requirements.title: Secure communication and sessions
requirements.description: TLS cookie security CSRF request limits CSP and password hashing.

requirements.title: Malicious content prevention
requirements.description: Escape displayed text and use parameterized SQL and bounded input.

requirements.title: Security audit and monitoring
requirements.description: Record login denial moderation recovery and message metadata without body or password.

requirements.title: Private reply and abuse control
requirements.description: Recipient-only replies; cap messages at ten per minute per sender.

requirements.title: Secure Docker packaging
requirements.description: Pinned dependencies non-root read-only rootfs least privilege TLS health check.

requirements.title: Kubernetes deployment
requirements.description: Restricted namespace limits secret PVC ClusterIP network policy.

requirements.title: Verified delivery pipeline
requirements.description: Checkout build tests static check dependency audit image package; fail on errors.

requirements.title: Accessible consistent interface
requirements.description: Responsive labelled controls error feedback cancel clear and progress views.

stories.story: As a campus user, I want to register and sign in so that I can access the service safely.
acceptance: Student and faculty register; administrator is provisioned by operator.
Automated check test_registration_valid passes or deployment evidence confirms the control.
No sensitive credentials are published in the implementation or evidence.
